author: FiJiLLiAn
quote:
This game is no where near what can be described as a perfect game. The game is undoubtedly a visually beautiful game and its world simulation of may not be outdone on this generation of consoles.

The biggest issue for me is that Rockstar said the game will render up to 30* FPS but on base PS5 it rarely stays there. Choosing the best visual fidelity and many systems to simulate is the reason why it was limited to render 30 FPS at the absolute maximum.

Other things that don’t make it feel like a GTA game is the morality and reputation system. It’s crazy that going to the extreme essentially locks you into that track for the rest of your play through. The other thing is the relationship management aka “boyfriend simulator” part of the game, that we were told we didn’t have to participate in, but if you don’t then you don’t get the “best ending”.

To sum it up, this game isn’t perfect and is an 8/10 at best. Maybe GTA VII will be different.

author: FiJiLLiAn
quote: The last time I played the original it was 1998 and I was 13 years old. I only played through it once and after I finished it I never went back but it always occupied my thoughts every now and again. This remake has brought back a lot of great memories. I am happy that I can make new ones with my kids and this remade version of a pioneering classic.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
